summary: Iteration 6 regression retest of the 3 fixes claimed after iteration_5. Backend: 93/93 pytest pass (49 backend_test.py + 36 test_vendor_phase1.py + 8 NEW test_iteration6_fixes.py) — PATCH /api/admin/orders/<id>/status accepts Accepted/Preparing/Ready (200, persisted) and still rejects 'Confirmed' (400); GET /api/admin/products returns approval_status + vendor_name with no _id leakage and supports ?status=pending; PATCH /api/admin/products/<id>/approval round-trips pending->hidden from public list, approved->visible, and rejects an invalid status; POST /api/products (admin) now returns approval_status='approved'. Frontend: FIX #3 VERIFIED (OrderDetail shows 'Coupon (WELCOME10) - Rs.6.50' and 65+30-6.50=88.50 reconciles, on both the old iteration-5 order and a brand-new COD order). FIX #2 PARTIALLY fixed — the Vendor/Approval columns and the Approve/Reject buttons now render with correct pending/approved badges, BUT clicking Approve does nothing because the handler `setApproval` is NOT DEFINED anywhere in Admin.jsx (ESLint no-undef confirms; product stayed approval_status='pending' after the UI click). FIX #1 NOT APPLIED AT ALL — Admin.jsx:440 ALL_STATUSES is still the old 6-item list ['Pending','Confirmed','Packed','Out For Delivery','Delivered','Cancelled'] in both the filter and the per-order status select. Sanity pack all green: customer login, PDP add-to-cart, cart, checkout coupon apply (Rs.95 -> Rs.88.50), COD order placement -> /orders/<id>, admin dashboard ('Approved vendors' label + pending callouts confirmed), vendor login/dashboard/products, vendor line-status Accepted propagating to the customer tracker with timestamps.

minor.issue: No approval_status filter — a pending/rejected product is still fetchable (200) by direct slug URL, so /products/<slug> renders an unapproved vendor product publicly. Ordering it is correctly blocked at checkout, but the PDP should 404. Verified while test-vendor-ui-tomato was pending.
Still raw dict payloads instead of Pydantic models (carried over from iteration_5).

Still no brute-force lockout / rate limiting on failed logins (playbook item 4). App uses JWT in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies, so cookie/CORS-credential playbook items do not apply; bcrypt $2b$ verified indirectly via login + seed_admin refresh.

ui_bugs.issue: FIX #1 NOT APPLIED. Verified in UI: status select options = ['Pending','Confirmed','Packed','Out For Delivery','Delivered','Cancelled'] and filter options = ['All', same 6]. Admin cannot set Accepted/Preparing/Ready; picking 'Confirmed' returns backend 400 'Invalid status'; an order in Accepted/Preparing/Ready has no matching option so the select visually falls back to 'Pending'. VendorDashboard.jsx already renders the correct 8-status list, so this is pure drift in Admin.jsx.

FIX #2 only half done: `setApproval` is referenced by the Approve/Reject onClick handlers but is NEVER DEFINED in the file (ESLint: "'setApproval' is not defined [no-undef]" x2). Clicking Approve on the pending product test-vendor-ui-tomato produced no request/toast, the row stayed 'pending' and GET /api/admin/products still reported approval_status='pending'. So there is STILL no working UI path to approve/reject a vendor product. Columns/badges themselves render correctly.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH /api/admin/products/<id>/approval is never called from the UI (undefined handler), so the dashboard 'N product(s) awaiting approval' callout remains non-actionable.

issues: Still not closable via Escape or backdrop click (carried over from iteration_5).
Expiry still uses the native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover (carried over).

Approve/Reject buttons are icon+text pills placed in the same cell as edit/delete icons; the 'Reject' pill is shown on every already-approved row, making the destructive action the most prominent control on 22/22 rows. Consider showing Reject only on pending rows or moving it behind a menu.
No issues — Subtotal / Delivery / Coupon / Total now reconcile on both screens.

action_items: Admin.jsx:440 — actually replace ALL_STATUSES with ['Pending','Accepted','Preparing','Packed','Ready','Out For Delivery','Delivered','Cancelled'] (ideally a shared constant imported by Admin.jsx, OrderDetail.jsx and VendorDashboard.jsx).

Admin.jsx ProductsAdmin — define the missing setApproval handler: `const setApproval = async (id, status) => { try { await api.patch(`/admin/products/${id}/approval`, { status }); toast.success(...); load(); } catch (e) { toast.error(formatApiError(e)); } }`. Currently both Approve and Reject buttons are dead.
Run `eslint` on the frontend before handoff — this exact bug is reported as no-undef and would have been caught pre-commit.
Optional: 404 GET /api/products/{slug} when approval_status != 'approved' so unapproved vendor products are not viewable by direct URL.

Optional (carried over): use a distinct status (not 'pending') when hiding a suspended/rejected vendor's products; add Pydantic models to the two dict-payload PATCH endpoints; split Admin.jsx (868 lines) and server.py (1271 lines).

Order status labels are STILL duplicated in 4 places and Admin.jsx is still the drifted copy; extract one exported constant to stop this recurring.
Admin.jsx 868 lines / server.py 1271 lines exceed the 700-line guideline.

rca_of_the_issue: Two of the three claimed frontend fixes are incomplete. FIX #1: the ALL_STATUSES constant at Admin.jsx:440 was never edited — the file still ships the pre-Phase-1 6-status list, so the backend's new ORDER_STATUSES are unreachable from /admin/orders and 'Confirmed' still yields 400. FIX #2: the JSX for the Vendor/Approval columns and the Approve/Reject buttons was added (and GET /admin/products is now used correctly), but the click handler function `setApproval` was never implemented — React resolves it to an undefined identifier, so the onClick throws/no-ops and PATCH /api/admin/products/<id>/approval is never issued. ESLint flags both button lines as no-undef, i.e. a lint run before handoff would have caught it. The backend for all three fixes is correct and fully covered by the 8 new pytest cases. FIX #3 (OrderDetail coupon row) is correctly implemented and verified end-to-end.
